pa_ir_cg_aksumite_group_trigger = {	# Imperator culture group aksumite_group
	scope:actor ?= {
		OR = {
			culture = culture:athagauan	# Imperator athagaun
			culture = culture:avalitian	# Imperator avalitian
			culture = culture:axumite	# Imperator aksumite
			culture = culture:beja_culture	# EU5 culture group
			culture = culture:berberian	# Imperator berberian
			culture = culture:beyte_yisrael	# EU5 culture group
			culture = culture:blemmyan	# Imperator blemmyan
			culture = culture:blemmye	# Imperator blemmye
			culture = culture:daamotic	# Imperator daamoti
			culture = culture:erythraean	# Imperator erythraean
			culture = culture:gurage	# EU5 culture group
			culture = culture:macrobian	# Imperator puntic
			culture = culture:onaean	# Imperator ona
			AND = {	# culture unknown to Imperator: capital in a province this group held in 304 BCE
				pa_ir_culture_known_trigger = no
				capital ?= {
					OR = {
						province_definition = province_definition:afar_province
						province_definition = province_definition:ajan_province
						province_definition = province_definition:akele_guzai_province

# ---- Imperator scripted triggers 00_flags.txt

pa_ir_has_celtic_flag_trigger = {
	OR = {
		pa_ir_cg_britannic_trigger = yes
		pa_ir_cg_celt_iberia_trigger = yes
		pa_ir_cg_gaelic_trigger = yes
		pa_ir_cg_gallic_trigger = yes
	}
}

pa_ir_has_barbarian_flag_trigger = {
	OR = {
		pa_ir_has_celtic_flag_trigger = yes
		pa_ir_cg_germanic_trigger = yes
	}
}

# ---- Map colours. Imperator picks flag colours from ROOT.color, which EU5 script cannot read; these list the
# tags (with no scripted flag) whose map colour passes the Imperator test. Regenerate after recolouring a tag.

pa_ir_colour_triggered_colors_list1_black_trigger = {	# Imperator: saturation <= 0.2 brightness <= 0.5
	scope:actor ?= {
		OR = {
			tag = AIL tag = AVG tag = CEL tag = CHV tag = DUMMY tag = EARE tag = IGN tag = LSN tag = OLL tag = PA3 tag = PIT tag = PRE
			tag = SMRT tag = THAS tag = TPL tag = UBI tag = Y07 tag = Y26
		}
	}
}
